Name: Verify Title Display When Flag is True
Objective: Verify that the adjustment screen displays correct title 'Scan location' when locationValidationRequired flag is set to true
Pre-condition: locationValidationRequired flag is set to true in system configuration
Test Step: 1. Navigate to adjustment workflow
2. Observe screen title

Name: Verify Title Display When Flag is False
Objective: Verify that the adjustment screen displays correct title 'Input adjustment and move items' when locationValidationRequired flag is set to false
Pre-condition: locationValidationRequired flag is set to false in system configuration
Test Step: 1. Navigate to adjustment workflow
2. Observe screen title
Test Result: Title displays 'Input adjustment and move items'

Name: Verify Title When Flag is Unset or Null
Objective: Verify system behavior when locationValidationRequired flag is null or undefined
Pre-condition: locationValidationRequired flag is null or undefined
Test Step: 1. Remove or unset locationValidationRequired flag from configuration
2. Navigate to adjustment workflow
Test Result: System handles gracefully with default behavior or appropriate error message

Name: Complete Location Scan Flow When Flag is True
Objective: Verify end-to-end flow from location scan to adjustment screen when flag is true
Pre-condition: locationValidationRequired flag is set to true. User has necessary permissions.
Test Step: 1. Navigate to adjustment workflow
2. Verify 'Scan location' title is displayed
3. Complete location scan by scanning valid location
4. Verify navigation to adjustment screen
5. Verify adjustment screen title is 'Input adjustment and move items'
Test Result: Title 'Input adjustment and move items' is displayed

Name: Attempt to Skip Location Scan When Flag is True
Objective: Verify that user cannot bypass location scan when locationValidationRequired is true
Pre-condition: locationValidationRequired flag is set to true. Location scan screen is displayed.
Test Step: 1. Navigate to adjustment workflow
Test Result: Adjustment workflow displays location scan screen

Test Step: 2. Attempt to bypass location scan screen (e.g. browser back or URL manipulation)
3. Try to access adjustment screen directly
Test Result: System prevents access; user must complete location scan

Name: Direct Access to Adjustment Screen When Flag is False
Objective: Verify user can directly access adjustment screen without location scan when flag is false
Pre-condition: locationValidationRequired flag is set to false
Test Step: 1. Navigate to adjustment workflow
2. Verify screen displays 'Input adjustment and move items' title
3. Verify no location scan screen is shown
Test Result: Location scan screen is not displayed; direct access to adjustment screen

Name: Verify Location Scan Screen Not Displayed When Flag is False
Objective: Verify that location scan screen is completely bypassed when flag is false
Pre-condition: locationValidationRequired flag is set to false
Test Step: 1. Navigate to adjustment workflow
2. Check for location scan screen in navigation flow
Test Result: Location scan screen is not displayed at any point

Name: Integration Between Location Scan and Adjustment Screen
Objective: Verify data is correctly passed from location scan to adjustment screen
Pre-condition: locationValidationRequired flag is set to true. Valid location data available.
Test Step: 1. Complete location scan with valid location
Test Data: TD-001: locationValidationRequired=true with valid location data

Test Step: 2. Verify data passed to adjustment screen
Test Result: Location data is passed to adjustment screen

Test Step: 3. Verify adjustment screen receives location context correctly
Test Result: Adjustment screen displays location context; operations are scoped to scanned location

Name: Multiple Location Scans in Same Session When Flag is True
Objective: Verify that repeated location scans in same session maintain correct flow and titles
Pre-condition: locationValidationRequired flag is set to true. User is authenticated.
Test Step: 1. Complete location scan and adjustment for first location
Test Data: TD-001: locationValidationRequired=true with Location A and Location B data
Test Result: First iteration completes successfully with 'Scan location' title

Test Step: 2. Navigate back to workflow to scan different location
3. Repeat location scan for second location
4. Verify each iteration maintains correct title and flow
Test Result: Both iterations show correct titles at each step; no state leak between iterations

Name: Navigation Performance When Flag is False
Objective: Verify adjustment screen loads within acceptable performance threshold when flag is false
Pre-condition: locationValidationRequired flag is set to false. Test environment is stable.
Test Step: 1. Navigate to adjustment workflow
2. Measure time from navigation start to adjustment screen display
Test Result: Screen displays within acceptable performance threshold (e.g. < 3 seconds)

Name: Back Navigation When Flag is False
Objective: Verify back navigation works correctly when accessing adjustment screen directly (flag is false)
Pre-condition: locationValidationRequired flag is set to false. User is on adjustment screen.
Test Step: 1. Navigate to and access adjustment screen
2. Press back button or use back navigation
Test Result: System navigates back to previous screen (not location scan screen)

Test Step: 3. Verify location scan screen is not shown in back navigation
Test Result: Location scan screen is not in navigation history

Name: UI Consistency - Title Text Matches Specification
Objective: Verify title text matches exact specification for both flag states
Pre-condition: None
Test Step: 1. Set locationValidationRequired flag to true
2. Navigate to adjustment workflow and verify exact text: 'Scan location'
Test Result: Exact text 'Scan location' is displayed (case-sensitive with no extra spaces)

Test Step: 3. Set locationValidationRequired flag to false
4. Navigate to adjustment workflow and verify exact text: 'Input adjustment and move items'
Test Result: Exact text 'Input adjustment and move items' is displayed (case-sensitive with spacing accurate)

Name: UI Consistency - Title Formatting
Objective: Verify title formatting is consistent regardless of flag value
Pre-condition: None
Test Step: 1. Set locationValidationRequired flag to true and observe title formatting
Test Result: Title displayed with consistent font size color alignment

Test Step: 2. Record title font size color and alignment
3. Set locationValidationRequired flag to false and observe title formatting
Test Result: Title displayed with same formatting parameters

Test Step: 4. Compare formatting between both states
Test Result: Formatting is identical (only text content differs)

Name: Flag Value Change During Runtime
Objective: Verify system handles flag value change during active workflow session
Pre-condition: User is in adjustment workflow with flag initially set to true. System allows runtime configuration changes.
Test Step: 1. Start workflow with locationValidationRequired=true
Test Data: TD-005: Runtime change true to false

Test Step: 2. Complete location scan
3. Change locationValidationRequired flag to false programmatically during session
Test Data: TD-005: flag changed to false at runtime

Test Step: 4. Observe system behavior and subsequent workflow navigation
Test Result: System handles flag change gracefully without errors or crashes; subsequent workflow respects new flag value

Name: Invalid Flag Values
Objective: Verify system handles invalid locationValidationRequired flag values gracefully
Pre-condition: None
Test Step: 1. Set locationValidationRequired to invalid string value 'true' (as string not boolean)
2. Navigate to adjustment workflow and observe behavior
Test Result: System handles with default behavior or validation error

Test Step: 3. Set locationValidationRequired to object {}
4. Navigate to adjustment workflow
Test Result: System handles with default behavior or validation error

Test Step: 5. Set locationValidationRequired to negative number -1
6. Navigate to adjustment workflow
Test Result: System handles with default behavior or validation error; no system crash

Name: Accessibility - Screen Reader Support
Objective: Verify screen reader correctly announces titles for both flag states
Pre-condition: Screen reader is enabled. User has accessibility requirements.
Test Step: 1. Enable screen reader software
2. Set locationValidationRequired to true and navigate to adjustment workflow
3. Verify screen reader announces 'Scan location'
Test Result: Screen reader correctly announces 'Scan location' with proper focus

Test Step: 4. Set locationValidationRequired to false and navigate to adjustment workflow
Test Result: Workflow loads with 'Input adjustment and move items' title

Test Step: 5. Verify screen reader announces 'Input adjustment and move items'
Test Result: Screen reader correctly announces full title with proper focus

Name: Internationalization - Title Display in Different Languages
Objective: Verify titles display correctly in supported non-English languages
Pre-condition: System is configured to support multiple languages. Language packs are installed.
Test Step: 1. Change system language to supported non-English locale (e.g. Spanish)
2. Set locationValidationRequired to true and verify title in Spanish
Test Result: Title displays correctly in Spanish (e.g. 'Escanear ubicación')

Test Step: 3. Set locationValidationRequired to false and verify title in Spanish
Test Result: Title displays correctly in Spanish (e.g. 'Ingresar ajuste y mover artículos')

Test Step: 4. Repeat for another supported language (e.g. French)
Test Result: Titles display correctly in French with proper translations

Name: Concurrent Users with Different Flag Values
Objective: Verify multiple users with different flag values see correct titles simultaneously
Pre-condition: Multi-user test environment. User A and User B accounts configured.
Test Step: 1. Configure User A with locationValidationRequired=true
Test Data: TD-006: User A flag=true User B flag=false

Test Step: 2. Configure User B with locationValidationRequired=false
3. User A navigates to adjustment workflow
4. User B navigates to adjustment workflow simultaneously
Test Result: User B sees 'Input adjustment and move items' title

Test Step: 5. Verify both users see correct titles based on their individual flag values
Test Result: Each user sees correct title; no cross-contamination of flag values between users

Name: Flag Configuration Persistence
Objective: Verify locationValidationRequired flag value persists across user sessions
Pre-condition: User account with locationValidationRequired configured
Test Step: 1. Set locationValidationRequired flag to false for user account
2. Navigate to adjustment workflow and verify title
Test Result: Title displays 'Input adjustment and move items'

Test Step: 3. Complete adjustment workflow
4. Logout from system
5. Login again with same user account
6. Navigate to adjustment workflow again
Test Result: Flag value persists; title still displays 'Input adjustment and move items'

Name: Edge Case - Rapid Flag Toggle
Objective: Verify system handles rapid flag value changes without errors
Pre-condition: None. System supports runtime flag configuration.
Test Step: 1. Create script or process to rapidly toggle locationValidationRequired between true and false
2. Execute rapid toggle (e.g. 10 toggles in 1 second)
3. Navigate to adjustment workflow immediately after toggle
4. Verify latest flag value is respected and correct title is displayed
Test Result: Latest flag value (true or false) is correctly applied; appropriate title is displayed
